output_list.code: function mint(address _owner, uint32 _heroClassId) onlyAccessMint public returns (uint256) {
output_list.reason: The function mint() allows anyone to mint a hero. This is a major vulnerability as it can be used to mint a large number of heroes at once, exhausting the supply and making the game unplayable for the original minters. The mint function should only be callable by the contract owner or the contract itself.
